name: overwatch
description: Catches a coding agent misbehaving, records it and makes the next session better: tasks and guards hold every stop until the work is done and reviewed, every catch lands in a ledger, and repeated habits plus recorded mistakes ride the next session's prompt. Also: compaction, one gauge line above the prompt, the tool-surface ledger with a repo's verification checks, /loadout, /hygiene and the disk gardener.

maxJudgeTokens.title: Guard judge: maximum estimated input tokens
maxJudgeTokens.description: Bounds the complete serialized guard judgment request. Oversized input remains unverified and blocks completion with instructions to narrow it. Invalid values use the default.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off turns compaction off (the baseline for measuring its savings). Tasks, guards and the ledgers stay on.

toolResultMaxChars.title: Tool result max chars
toolResultMaxChars.description: Older tool results are cut to this many characters (head and tail kept).

outcomeMaxChars.title: Failed call outcome max chars
outcomeMaxChars.description: Older failed tool results are cut to this many characters.

liveResultMaxChars.title: Live tool result max chars
liveResultMaxChars.description: Aggregate serialized text-result budget, including errors and reports (minimum 512). Exact file tools and native media are preserved. Shortening requires a stored original; decompress returns exact bounded pages.

keepThreshold.title: Fold: keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Jev grades each folded tool call 0 to 1. At or above this, the fold index keeps the head of its result; below, only a short head or the id.

truncateHeadChars.title: Fold: chars kept of a dropped result
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters Jev keeps of a result it drops when it rebuilds the conversation. The fold index sets its own heads from the grade, so this changes nothing visible today.

maxStateTokens.title: Fold: history sent to the grader (tokens)
maxStateTokens.description: Upper bound on the conversation history sent to Jev as background for one fold.

maxRequestTokens.title: Fold: grader request size (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Upper bound on one Jev request; a larger fold is graded in several requests.

maxTotalTokens.title: Fold: total grader input budget (tokens)
maxTotalTokens.description: Maximum estimated input across all requests in one fold. Over-budget folds use deterministic heads. 0 disables paid grading.

maxRequests.title: Fold: maximum grader requests
maxRequests.description: Maximum requests per fold. Batches run sequentially; failed requests are not retried. 0 disables paid grading.

keepRecentTokens.title: Recent tokens kept whole
keepRecentTokens.description: Newest tokens (chars/4) a fold leaves as they are; the cut moves back to a turn start.

maxFrozenIndexChars.title: Fold: maximum consolidated index characters
maxFrozenIndexChars.description: One index keeps durable summary lines and recent tool heads. If mandatory lines cannot fit, folding is skipped and context retained. Originals and full indexes stay archived.

compactEveryTokens.title: Context growth between folds
compactEveryTokens.description: A fold rewrites the prompt cache once; it runs after the context grew this many tokens since the last fold.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Idle this long, the prompt cache is cold; a fold then costs no cache rewrite, so one runs.

foldFromTokens.title: Context before the first fold
foldFromTokens.description: A fold makes the next request write every message to the prompt cache again; it only pays on a big context. No fold below this many tokens.

diskFullPercent.title: Disk nearly full (percent used)
diskFullPercent.description: From this percent used on the project's disk, the agent is asked once to run the disk gardener: this project first, then the whole disk. 0 turns the ask off.

slots.title: Gauges above the prompt
slots.description: Comma-separated slot ids in draw order; a published slot not listed is not drawn. `plan` is the tasks-and-guards gauge.

toolGroups.title: Optional tool groups
toolGroups.description: Comma-separated vault, prd (includes vault), maintenance, background, changelog; all enables every tool. Empty keeps core planning, checks and feedback. Restart the host after changing.
